prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1485; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The same service was billed twice for the same date, and the provider admitted the second charge was a repeat.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot, reporting pain and swelling in the right knee. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of impact and the location of symptoms. Over the course of ten visits, care progressed through a conservative plan including physical examination, targeted therapeutic exercise, and activity modification. Treatment followed a typical trajectory, with visit frequency reduced as pain and range of motion improved. Examination revealed effusion and tenderness along the joint line that support the reported injury, while ligamentous stability testing and neurovascular assessment were within normal limits. The patient mentioned a minor strain to the same knee several years ago, which had resolved completely without lasting limitation. A billing review identified one service recorded twice on the same date; the provider acknowledged the second entry was a duplicate and it has been noted for correction. Patient is expected to return to baseline function with continued home exercise.
